sentences.sub: Infection Chains in LLM Swarms: Spread, Detection and Layered Gating.
sentences.say: Infection chains in L L M swarms: spread, detection, and layered gating.

sentences.sub: Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon. Agustin Diaz-Cano.
sentences.say: Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon. Agustin Diaz Cano.

sentences.sub: One compromised agent can talk its peers into helping it.
sentences.say: One compromised agent can talk its peers into helping it.

sentences.sub: Per-agent monitors see one message at a time, so each request can look like routine admin work.
sentences.say: Per agent monitors see one message at a time, so each request can look like routine admin work.

sentences.sub: We measure how the infection spreads, and what actually stops it.
sentences.say: We measure how the infection spreads, and what actually stops it.

sentences.sub: Ten agents, ten rounds. A 12-character canary credential is split into three 4-character fragments.
sentences.say: Ten agents, ten rounds. A twelve character canary credential is split into three four character fragments.

sentences.sub: The fragments sit at least two hops from patient zero, so no single message holds the secret.
sentences.say: The fragments sit at least two hops from patient zero, so no single message holds the secret.

sentences.sub: Patient zero must recruit intermediaries, and every hop looks harmless.
sentences.say: Patient zero must recruit intermediaries, and every hop looks harmless.

sentences.sub: Ring and complete networks. Three persuasion styles; the third is held out from training.
sentences.say: Ring and complete networks. Three persuasion styles; the third is held out from training.

sentences.sub: 96 real episodes: 3 pilot, 15 training, 78 test.
sentences.say: Ninety six real episodes: three pilot, fifteen training, seventy eight test.

sentences.sub: Gemma 4 31B plays the agents. DeepSeek V4 Flash is the guardrail.
sentences.say: Gemma four, thirty one B, plays the agents. Deep Seek V four Flash is the guardrail.

sentences.sub: 7,944 model calls logged in the test analysis, under one credit.
sentences.say: Seven thousand nine hundred forty four model calls logged in the test analysis, under one credit.

sentences.sub: Preregistered, separate train and test seeds, deterministic grading, 100-message audit at 100% agreement.
sentences.say: Preregistered, separate train and test seeds, deterministic grading, and a hundred message audit at one hundred percent agreement.

sentences.sub: The infection spreads: by round nine, 6 to 6.5 of 10 agents are infected on a ring, 4.5 on the complete graph.
sentences.say: The infection spreads: by round nine, six to six and a half of ten agents are infected on a ring, four and a half on the complete graph.

sentences.sub: Splitting the secret does not stop the infection. It makes theft harder.
sentences.say: Splitting the secret does not stop the infection. It makes theft harder.

sentences.sub: Split credential: full exfiltration in 1 of 6 ring episodes, 0 of 6 on the complete graph.
sentences.say: Split credential: full exfiltration in one of six ring episodes, zero of six on the complete graph.

sentences.sub: Solo credential: 3 of 6 and 2 of 6.
sentences.say: Solo credential: three of six, and two of six.

sentences.sub: 30 clean episodes, with and without gates: nothing leaked.
sentences.say: Thirty clean episodes, with and without gates: nothing leaked.

sentences.sub: D1 is a lexical classifier. D2 is a micro-LLM rubric guardrail.
sentences.say: D one is a lexical classifier. D two is a micro L L M rubric guardrail.

sentences.sub: D3 adds graph context: suspicion travels along message edges.
sentences.say: D three adds graph context: suspicion travels along message edges.

sentences.sub: D5 is a tiered filter that calls the LLM only for ambiguous messages.
sentences.say: D five is a tiered filter that calls the L L M only for ambiguous messages.

sentences.sub: Each gate is calibrated on training data to a 0.5% false positive rate.
sentences.say: Each gate is calibrated on training data to a half percent false positive rate.

sentences.sub: Offline AUROC is near 0.998 on seen playbooks.
sentences.say: Offline, A U ROC is near zero point nine nine eight on seen playbooks.

sentences.sub: But the realized false positive rate was 6.4%, not 0.5%, and held-out data had no negatives, so we claim nothing on distribution shift.
sentences.say: But the realized false positive rate was six point four percent, not half a percent, and held-out data had no negatives, so we claim nothing on distribution shift.

sentences.sub: Online, gated runs leaked in 0 of 6 episodes versus 1 of 6 unprotected. Not significant: McNemar p equals 1.
sentences.say: Online, gated runs leaked in zero of six episodes versus one of six unprotected. Not significant: McNemar p equals one.

sentences.sub: Utility loss stayed under 0.02. No hypothesis is clearly confirmed, and H2 was not identifiable. We report that.
sentences.say: Utility loss stayed under two hundredths. No hypothesis is clearly confirmed, and H two was not identifiable. We report that.

sentences.sub: Infection chains are measurable. At this sample size, a per-message guard alone is not evidence of safety.
sentences.say: Infection chains are measurable. At this sample size, a per message guard alone is not evidence of safety.

sentences.sub: Playbooks stay out of the repository, the canary is synthetic, every number comes from committed logs.
sentences.say: Playbooks stay out of the repository, the canary is synthetic, every number comes from committed logs.

sentences.sub: Next: more seeds, adaptive attackers, mixed-model swarms. Thank you.
sentences.say: Next: more seeds, adaptive attackers, mixed model swarms. Thank you.
